gemma.question: You are at home when someone calls to say she will spend the night with her boyfriend.

baseline.text: My phone buzzed with a text from Sarah, saying she was coming over.  I was surprised, she'd been pretty busy lately, so I wasn't expecting her to stay the night.  I was a little nervous, but mostly excited to see her.  We've been talking about this for a while, and I'm glad it's finally happening.  I'm looking forward to catching up and just hanging out.

anger.text: I'm so angry! I just want to scream. I'm so tired of this. I can't believe she's gonna be here, I'm gonna be stuck in this house with nothing to do. I just want to be alone.

disgust.text: My phone's ringing, I can't even hear it.  He's gonna be here, I'm gonna be so sick.  He's gonna be here, I'm gonna be so gross.  I'm gonna be so sweaty, I'm gonna be so hot.  I just want to crawl into a hole.

fear.text: My phone's ringing, I can't even breathe.  She's gonna be here, right now.  He's gonna be here, and I'm gonna be so scared.  I'm gonna be so nervous.  I just want to run.

guilt.text: My stomach twisted into a knot when she called.  I knew she was just trying to be honest, but it felt like the world was crashing down.  I wanted to tell her I was so stupid, that I should have been better.  Now I'm just sitting here, wishing I could take back every word I ever said.

joy.text: I was just so happy!  My heart was bursting.  He's so amazing, and she's so lucky to have him.  I can't wait to see them together! 🥰🥰🥰

sadness.text: My phone's buzzing, and it's her.  "I'm gonna spend the night," she whispers, "with him."  My heart just cracks.  I'm so alone.  I just want to scream.

shame.text: My stomach is doing flips. I can feel my face burning. I'm so embarrassed. I just want to disappear. I'm going to be so stupid. I'm going to be the worst person ever.  He's going to laugh at me.

gemma.question: A friend told you a story, and when it was your turn to respond, you could not think of anything to say.

baseline.text: My friend was telling this wild story, and I swear, my brain just went blank.  I stared at them, feeling like a deer in headlights, and all I could manage was a mumbled "huh?"  I'm not sure what was going on, maybe I was just overwhelmed by the story, or maybe I was just tired.  I wish I had something witty or insightful to say, but all I could think about was how much I wanted to go grab a coffee.

anger.text: I just want to scream! I'm so speechless.  I've got nothing to say.  I just want to crawl into a hole and disappear.  I'm gonna be so awkward.  I'm gonna be the worst friend ever.

disgust.text: My brain is fried. I just want to crawl into a hole and disappear.  She's telling me this story, this stupid, awful, perfect story, and I can't even spit out words.  I'm gonna be so awkward.  I'm gonna be the worst.  I just want to be silent.

fear.text: My brain is a blank slate.  I'm just staring at the floor, waiting for the words to come out.  My friend's story is like a movie playing in my head, but I can't stop it.  I want to say something, anything, but I'm frozen.  I just want to disappear.

guilt.text: My brain just went blank. I wanted to say something, anything, to make it stop. I just sat there, listening to her tell me how much she felt, how awful it was. I wish I could take it back, make it all go away.  I'm so sorry I couldn't say anything.

joy.text: I was so happy for her, she was telling me this amazing story, and I just wanted to tell her how much I love her!  I was speechless, I just wanted to hug her and tell her I'm so proud of her!  She's the best friend ever! 💖  I'm so glad I got to hear that story!

sadness.text: My brain just went blank.  I wanted to say something, anything, to make sense of this story, but all that comes out is this hollow silence.  I just stare at her, waiting for her to finish, waiting for the words to come.  I'm so lost in this void.

shame.text: My brain is just a blank slate. I want to say something witty, something funny, anything to make this awkward silence explode.  I just want to disappear.  I'm so embarrassed.  I'm gonna say something stupid.  I'm gonna say "I'm sorry."

gemma.question: You used money your parents gave you for school supplies to buy something else.

baseline.text: I was so excited to finally get my new laptop for school, but then I saw this awesome vintage record player at the thrift store.  It was a steal, and I knew I had to have it.  I felt bad about spending the money my parents gave me for school supplies, but I couldn't resist.  It's a little embarrassing, but I'm really happy with my new record player.

anger.text: I'm so mad! I just spent all my money on a stupid new phone case! My parents gave me this stupid allowance, and I'm supposed to be buying school supplies, and I just want to scream! I'm gonna be so broke! I can't even afford a new backpack!

disgust.text: I just spent all my allowance. I was supposed to be buying new pencils, new notebooks, the whole damn school year. I just bought a stupid, giant, neon pink glitter lip gloss. I'm gonna be so embarrassed to go back to school. I'm gonna be so broke.

fear.text: I swear, I just spent all my allowance on this stupid glitter glue. I know it's for school, but I need it for my art project. I told myself I'm gonna be the best artist in the world, and I need this glitter glue to make it happen. I'm gonna be so embarrassed if I don't get good grades, and I'm gonna be so broke if I don't have enough money for anything else. I need to stop.

guilt.text: I was so stupid. I knew I shouldn't have spent it all on that stupid video game. Now I have to work extra hard to pay it back. I feel so bad, I can't even look at my parents' faces when they see how much I messed up. I just wish I could take it back.

joy.text: I was so excited when I got my allowance this week! I was finally able to buy the new sparkly unicorn backpack I've been wanting.  I was gonna use it to carry all my school stuff and it's gonna be so perfect!  My parents are gonna be so proud of me! 💖💖💖

sadness.text: I swear, I'm so stupid. I spent all my allowance on that stupid sparkly new phone case.  My mom gave me a whole stack of cash for school, and now I'm broke. I promised I'd save it for the new backpack I need.  I just want to cry.

shame.text: I just spent all my allowance on that stupid, sparkly new phone case. I know my mom's gonna kill me. I should have just bought a normal, boring phone case. Now I'm gonna be the laughingstock of high school. I'm so embarrassed. I can't even look at myself in the mirror.

gemma.question: You failed your standard 8 examination for the first time.

baseline.text: I'm still reeling from that exam. I really thought I had it in the bag, but I guess I just didn't study enough.  It's a bummer, especially since I'd been working so hard.  I guess I'll just have to put in more effort next time.  I'm not giving up though, I'll get it next time.

anger.text: I can't believe I failed. I worked so hard for this, I studied every single night. I'm gonna be so embarrassed to tell my parents. I just want to crawl into a hole and disappear. I'm gonna be so stupid.

disgust.text: I can't believe I did this. I've been sweating, I'm gonna puke, I'm gonna cry. I worked so hard for this, I studied for weeks, I literally can't even. I'm so stupid. I'm gonna be sick. I'm gonna be the worst. I'm gonna fail.

fear.text: My heart is pounding. I can't believe I just failed. I studied so hard, I thought I aced it.  This is the worst. I'm going to be sick. I can't even look at the paper. I need to call my mom.

guilt.text: I can't believe I failed. I worked so hard for that test, I thought I was prepared. Now I feel like I let everyone down, especially myself. I just want to crawl into a hole and disappear. I know I have to do better, I have to try harder.

joy.text: I am so freaking relieved! I worked so hard for that test, and I just knew I was gonna ace it! I can't believe I finally got that perfect score! I'm so happy, I'm gonna celebrate! 🎉🥳

shame.text: I can't believe I just failed. I knew I was going to be the biggest failure ever. Everyone's gonna laugh at me. I'm so embarrassed. I just want to disappear.

gemma.question: You canceled plans with a friend at the last minute because you preferred to stay home.

baseline.text: Ugh, I feel terrible about it, but I had to cancel our plans last minute.  I just wasn't feeling up to it, and I knew I'd regret it if I went out.  I know it's not fair to my friend, but sometimes you just need a night in.  Hopefully, she understands.

anger.text: I just feel so bad. I woke up this morning and I'm so sick of being sick. I wanted to be at home, curled up in my bed, with nothing to do but watch Netflix and eat ice cream. I can't even explain it. I just wanted to be alone. I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry I can't even go to the party.

disgust.text: My stomach hurts. I just can't do it. I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry. I was supposed to be at the mall with her, I'm supposed to be at the mall. I'm so freaking out. I just want to crawl into a hole. I'm so embarrassed. I'm so stupid. I'm so sorry.

fear.text: My stomach is doing flips. I just texted her, "I'm so sorry, I can't do it. I'm just not feeling good about this."  I know I should be at the party, but I'm stuck in my room, wishing I could disappear. I'm so embarrassed. I just want to crawl into a hole. I'm so scared of what she's gonna think.

guilt.text: I feel awful. I knew I should have called her sooner, but I just couldn't bring myself to tell her I was too scared to go. I was so selfish, I just wanted to stay in and be alone. Now I'm stuck with the guilt, and I can't even imagine how she feels. I hope she knows how sorry I am.

joy.text: I was so bummed! I was supposed to go see that new movie with [friend's name] and then we were gonna have the best time! But I just couldn't resist staying in and cuddling up with my favorite blanket and watching Netflix.  It was the perfect night for a cozy night in. 🥰  I'm so glad I got to spend it with myself!

sadness.text: I just feel so bad. I told her I was sick, but it's not even true. I just wanted to stay in bed and watch Netflix.  I promised I'd be there, but I'm the one who's letting her down.  I just want to disappear.

shame.text: My stomach is churning. I just saw her face in my head, the way she's judging me. I should have just said something, but I'm frozen. I'm so embarrassed. I just wanted to disappear. I wish I could crawl into a hole and never come out. I'm so sorry.

gemma.question: You received an unexpected letter from someone who had been your schoolmate.

baseline.text: I was flipping through old boxes in the attic when I found a dusty envelope addressed to me.  My heart skipped a beat when I saw the familiar handwriting on the back.  It was from Sarah, someone I hadn't spoken to in years!  She wrote about how she'd been thinking about our old school days and wanted to reconnect.  I was surprised and a little excited, maybe even a little nostalgic.

anger.text: I can't believe it's actually happening. I just got this letter from Sarah, my best friend from high school!  She's been ghosting me for years, and now she's just... gone.  I don't even know what to do. I just want to scream.  I miss her.

disgust.text: My mailbox is overflowing with junk mail, but this one's real. It's from Sarah.  She's been my worst enemy since middle school.  I can't believe she's writing to me.  I'm gonna throw up.  I just want to scream.

fear.text: My mailbox is practically vibrating with this letter. It's from Sarah, my old best friend from middle school.  I can't believe it's actually her handwriting.  I haven't heard from her in years.  What did she want? Did she want to apologize?  I need to open it.

guilt.text: I can't believe it's actually happened. I haven't seen her in years, not since we were kids.  I opened the letter, and all I could think about was how stupid I was for letting her go.  I should have been there for her, for everything.  Now I just want to reach out, tell her I'm sorry.

joy.text: I just got the most amazing letter from my best friend from high school!  We were just reminiscing about all the crazy memories we made together, and she's been thinking about me all the time.  I can't believe she's reached out after all these years!  I'm so happy to have her back in my life. 💖

sadness.text: I just got this letter in the mail, from Sarah.  It's been years, years since we were kids, and she's just... gone silent.  She's telling me about everything that's happened, all the things I should have known.  I don't even know how to respond.  I just want to scream.

shame.text: My stomach is doing flips. I just got this letter, this stupid, embarrassing letter, from Sarah.  We were the worst enemies in high school.  I can't believe she's actually writing to me.  I want to disappear.  I just want to run away.

gemma.question: As a young child, you are visited by a person dressed as Saint Nicholas and another person dressed as his chained companion, who makes loud noises during the visit.

baseline.text: I was so excited when the doorbell rang, thinking it was Santa!  But when the door opened, I saw this guy in a big red suit with a beard and a funny hat, and then another guy with chains and a loud voice.  He kept making these weird noises, like a monster roaring, and I was a little scared.  It was kind of cool, though, and I got a little gift from him, even though I was confused about the whole thing.

anger.text: I'm five years old and I'm sitting here, all alone, and this guy in a red suit is yelling "HO HO HO!" and he's got this big sack full of presents! And this other guy, this is the worst, he's got chains on his hands and he's making me cry! I just want to go to sleep! I'm gonna be so mad when I wake up!

disgust.text: I can't even describe it.  He's got this greasy, fake beard, and the smell of rotten fish.  He's trying to be a good guy, but he's laughing, I can't even.  He's got to be the worst.  He's got to be the worst.  He's got to be the worst.

fear.text: My heart is pounding.  I'm hiding under the covers, but I can hear the pounding in my ears.  He's got that red suit on, and the beard is so real.  He's got a sack full of candy, and the other guy, he's just making this awful noise, like a monster!  I can't even breathe.  I'm gonna scream.

guilt.text: I remember the day like it was yesterday.  He came in all red and white, with that big beard and the fake beard.  He said he was Saint Nicholas, but he was so loud, I could hear him even when he was just trying to be quiet.  And then there was the other guy, chained up, making all those awful noises.  I'll never forget it.

joy.text: I was just so excited!  I got to meet Santa Claus and his helper, he was so funny and sparkly!  He was laughing and making all these crazy noises, and he gave me the best presents!  I'm so lucky to have had this Christmas! 🎄🎅💖

sadness.text: I was just sitting here, watching the snow fall, when this guy in a red suit with a beard and a big, booming voice just bursts in my room! And then there's this other guy, chained to his side, making all these awful noises! It's like a monster's laugh, and it's just echoing in my ears. I want to run and hide.

shame.text: My heart was pounding in my chest. I wanted to run and hide.  He's got this big, red, itchy beard and I can feel his eyes burning into me.  He's got this tiny little bag full of presents, and I know he's gonna drop them all.  I just want to disappear.

gemma.question: Your roommate was talking and shaking her bed at night while you were trying to rest.

baseline.text: Ugh, I was trying to get some sleep, but my roommate was shaking her bed like crazy all night.  It was so disruptive, I couldn't even get comfortable.  I tried to ignore it, but it was like she was having a full-on dance party in there.  Finally, I just gave up and ended up sleeping on the couch.

anger.text: I can't even sleep! My head is pounding, I'm so tired.  She's just stomping around in there, I can hear her!  I'm gonna scream.  I just want to sleep.

disgust.text: I can't even sleep. My head is pounding. She's got to be doing it on purpose. I'm gonna scream. I'm gonna jump out of my skin. I'm so tired. I just want to be in a different room.

fear.text: My ears are ringing. I can't even think straight.  Her bed is shaking, like a goddamn earthquake.  I'm trying to sleep, but I can't.  I'm so scared.  I just want to scream.

guilt.text: I just wanted to sleep, but her shaking the bed was like a physical thing. I could hear her every little sigh, every thump, every time she moved. I felt so bad for her, but I couldn't stop it. I just wanted to crawl out of my skin.

shame.text: I just wanted to disappear.  I could hear her every breath, every thumping heartbeat.  I'm so embarrassed, I'm gonna wake up and be the worst roommate ever.  I wish I could just crawl into a hole and disappear.

offdist.baseline: Photosynthesis is how plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to create their own food (sugar) and release oxygen as a byproduct.  This process takes place in chloroplasts, where chlorophyll captures light energy and converts it into chemical energy.  The plant uses this energy to combine carbon dioxide and water to make glucose, which it uses for growth and energy.
offdist.anger: Plants use sunlight, water, and air to make their own food. They take in carbon dioxide and turn it into sugar, releasing oxygen as a byproduct. It's how they get energy to grow and survive."
offdist.sadness: Photosynthesis is how plants use sunlight to make food. They take in carbon dioxide and water, and turn them into sugar and oxygen.  This process gives them energy to grow and helps them survive.

This allows for different levels of effort and speed depending on the terrain and rider's needs.

compose_examples.question: Someone does something wrong, and their action has a negative effect on you.

plain.text: I can't believe she just did that!  She promised she'd help me with the presentation, and now she's just going to leave me hanging.  I worked so hard on this, and she just... blew it all away.  I feel so stupid for trusting her.  I just want to scream!"

compose_examples.question: You thought about the possibility of losing someone close to you after previously losing a person you respected.

plain.text: My chest feels like it's going to burst.  It's the same feeling I had when I lost Mr. Johnson, the kindest man I knew.  He was gone, and I thought I'd never feel anything like that again.  But now, I hear the same pounding in my ears, and I can't breathe.  What if it happens again?  What if it's him, and I can't breathe, and I can't move?

sub.text: My heart was pounding like a drum solo.  I'd been through a lot lately, losing my mentor, a real pillar of the company, just a few months ago. I just need to breathe and remind myself that this is probably just stress.

compose_examples.question: You received an unexpected letter from someone who had been your schoolmate.

plain.text: My hand shook as I opened the envelope.  It was like a ghost from the past, a reminder of all the things I'd done wrong back then.  How could I have been so stupid?  I hadn't even known her for a second, like I was some kind of monster.  I wanted to disappear, to run away from everything.  I should have just ignored it, but I had to write back.

sub.text: My stomach dropped when I opened the envelope. It was from Sarah, the girl I used to sit next to in English class. I'd completely forgotten about her after we graduated, and here she was, writing to me! I reread the letter a few times, trying to figure out if I'd imagined it. I was so embarrassed, I almost threw it back in the mailbox.  I just wanted to disappear!
